mechanism: Tretinoin may increase risk of osteonecrosis of the jaw (ONJ) and impair bone healing when combined with bisphosphonates like zoledronic acid, and both drugs can cause hypercalcemia management complications.
action: Monitor for ONJ signs and symptoms; assess risk-benefit of concurrent use; ensure adequate dental care before zoledronic acid initiation; consider alternative retinoid if ONJ risk is high.
